placeholder.input: Ask {{provider}} to continue, review changes, or bind a project to this shell...
empty-state.title: Empty-state guardrail
empty-state.message: This shell intentionally avoids file-tree-first landing, terminal takeover, and fake provider output. The center lane stays reserved for the next real conversation.
proof.title: What this shell already proves
proof.message: The startup path, layered app structure, and visible execution context are already in place, so later stories can deepen capabilities without rewriting the stage.
proof.step-1: Main window opens directly into the desktop workbench.
proof.step-2: Main / preload / renderer layers are split and ready for typed RPC expansion.
proof.step-3: The shell keeps project, conversation, provider, worktree and run status visible.
hero.title: Start from chat, then fan out to review tools only when needed.
hero.description: The central lane remains conversational. Import a local project first, then bind provider, worktree and run state as always-visible context instead of promoting them to top-level navigation.
